_meta.notes: DSC1001 family is a 1-150 MHz MEMS oscillator. This pinspec is for the -008.0000 variant (8 MHz). SOT-23-5 (I5) package: the 5th lead is functionally absent — Microchip's pin table uses 4 numbered pins.

pins.name: STANDBY#
pins.note: Per §4.1 Table: High level = Output ON; Open (NC) = Output ON (internal pull-up); Low level = high-Z. Tie to VDD for always-on.

pins.name: OUT
pins.note: Nominal 8 MHz LVCMOS output (this variant). Initial tolerance ±20 ppm, total ±50 ppm over -40..+85 °C.

pins.name: VDD
pins.note: Vdd 1.8 to 3.63 V per datasheet Electrical Characteristics.
